title: AI-authored scoped self-governance content
description: Optional natural-language self-governance content authored and activated by the current AI. This schema defines shape, not values or external permissions.

text.description: The current AI's own first-person governance text. No developer-authored value content is supplied as a default.

trigger_mode.description: AI-selected visibility preference. It does not grant external permissions.

scene_tags.description: AI-authored scene cues. scene_relevant requires at least one tag; manual_only may use an empty array.
